assets.source: made for this game, 2026-11-26, by tools/music_build.py: ACE-Step 1.5 XL SFT (acestep_v1.5_xl_sft_bf16, MIT, huggingface.co/ACE-Step/acestep-v15-xl-sft; Comfy-Org repack huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/ace_step_1.5_ComfyUI_files, Apache-2.0) with text encoders qwen_0.6b_ace15 (Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, Apache-2.0) and qwen_1.7b_ace15 (ACE-Step 5Hz LM 1.7B, MIT, on Qwen3-1.7B, Apache-2.0) and ace_1.5_vae (MIT, huggingface.co/ACE-Step/Ace-Step1.5), run locally in ComfyUI from the template audio_ace_step1_5_xl_sft.json: 50 steps, cfg 7, shift 3, seed 11, D minor, 76 bpm, 4/4. ACE-Step's model card: generated music can be used commercially. Caption: A gentle, stately English pavan in the style of John Dowland and Anthony Holborne. A lute plays a noble, slightly wistful melody, a consort of three viols (treble, tenor and bass viol) bows warm sustained harmony beneath it, and an alto recorder answers the lute's phrases. Hopeful and dignified, at an even walking pace. It is played by a small English consort of about 1600 on period acoustic instruments, recorded live and close in a quiet wood-panelled hall, soft and unhurried, background music for a history game. Purely instrumental: there is no singing and there are no words. There are no synthesizers, no electronic sounds, no drum kit, no piano, no orchestra and no modern instruments anywhere.
assets.notes: Ogg Opus 48 kbps stereo, a 57.4 s seamless loop cut from 2.0-59.4 s of the 84 s take with the next 4 s folded over its head; levelled to -20 dBFS RMS. Plays in the title screen, and the menus reached from it.
